name: TikTok LIVE
description: Turns your TikTok LIVE into flow triggers: gifts by coins or by gift, battles, joins, follows, likes, chat and milestones, plus inputs about the stream. Unofficial; built on tiktok-live-connector 2.5.0, with a TikFinity bridge as an alternative.

tabs.label: General
tabs.description: The LIVE to watch and how to reach it.

tabs.label: Direct connection
tabs.description: Connecting to TikTok through Euler Stream's signing service.

tabs.label: TikFinity
tabs.description: Listening to the TikFinity desktop app instead.

tabs.label: Chat (BETA)
tabs.description: Sending chat messages. Unstable and off by default.

tabs.label: Advanced
tabs.description: Gift streaks, milestones and other events.

tabs.label: About
tabs.description: Third-party software this plugin is built on.

fields.label: Plugin enabled
fields.description: Watches the LIVE while OSC Flow Studio is open.

fields.label: TikTok username
fields.description: The @handle of the account that goes live, with or without the @. The plugin waits when it is offline and connects when the LIVE starts.

fields.label: Connect through
fields.description: Direct connects to TikTok itself. TikFinity listens to the TikFinity app on this computer, which has to be open and connected to your LIVE.

fields.label: Reset per stream
fields.description: Starts the session counters (coins, likes, gifters, milestones) over when a new LIVE starts.

fields.label: Command prefix
fields.description: Chat messages that start with this are also chat commands.

fields.label: Euler Stream signing
fields.description: TikTok only accepts signed connections, and the direct connection gets its signatures from Euler Stream. Without a key it shares Euler's free anonymous limit, which can make connecting wait a few minutes. A free key at eulerstream.com raises it; the gift list and sending chat need paid plans.

fields.label: Euler Stream API key
fields.description: Optional. Kept in the Studio's encrypted vault and sent only to Euler Stream.

fields.label: First retry after (seconds)
fields.description: When the connection drops, the plugin waits this long, then twice as long after each failure.

fields.label: Longest wait between retries (seconds)
fields.description: Waits after a rate limit are never shorter than 60 seconds.

fields.label: Check if live every (seconds)
fields.description: While the streamer is offline. These checks do not use Euler Stream's quota.

fields.label: TikFinity bridge
fields.description: Open TikFinity on this computer, connect it to your LIVE, and pick TikFinity app under General. Gifts, chat, likes, follows, shares, joins, subscriptions and battles arrive through it; the gift list, live checks and sending chat do not.

fields.label: TikFinity address
fields.description: TikFinity's local WebSocket. Change it only if TikFinity tells you a different one.

fields.label: Sending chat is BETA
fields.description: It may stop working or be switched off by the plugin maintainers at any time. TikTok may suspend accounts that post automatically: use a secondary account. It needs the direct connection and an Euler Stream key on a plan that includes chat.

fields.label: Chat (BETA) enabled
fields.description: Allows TikTok: send chat message. Sign in with the TikTok: chat sign-in block, which gives you a page to open in your browser.

fields.label: Count streakable gifts
fields.description: When a viewer taps a Rose 10 times, gift received fires once with 10, or ten times with 1.

fields.label: Session coin milestone every
fields.description: Coins. 0 turns session coin milestones off.

fields.label: Viewer coin milestone every
fields.description: Coins from one viewer. 0 turns them off.

fields.label: Like milestone every
fields.description: Likes on the LIVE's total. 0 turns them off.

fields.label: Viewer milestone every
fields.description: Viewers. 0 turns them off.

fields.label: Replay recent messages on connect
fields.description: TikTok sends a few recent messages when the plugin connects. Off ignores them, so a reconnect does not fire old events again.

fields.label: Pass other events
fields.description: Fires TikTok: other TikTok event for every message type the plugin does not handle itself. For experiments; it can fire often.

fields.label: Unofficial integration
fields.description: TikTok has no public API for LIVE events. This plugin reads the same events every LIVE alert tool reads, and is not affiliated with TikTok, Euler Stream or TikFinity.

fields.label: tiktok-live-connector 2.5.0
fields.description: The TikTok client the direct connection uses, by zerodytrash. AGPL-3.0 with additional permissions. https://github.com/zerodytrash/TikTok-Live-Connector

fields.label: tiktok-live-proto
fields.description: TikTok's message definitions, by isaackogan. AGPL-3.0 with additional permissions. https://github.com/isaackogan/TikTok-Webcast-Protobuf

fields.label: Euler Stream
fields.description: The signing service behind the direct connection. https://www.eulerstream.com

fields.label: TikFinity
fields.description: The desktop app behind the TikFinity bridge, not bundled. https://tikfinity.zerody.one

fields.label: Licenses
fields.description: Every bundled package and its license is listed in vendor/NOTICE.md inside the plugin, with full texts in vendor/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt. Source: https://github.com/OSC-Flow-Studio/official-community-plugins/tree/main/plugins/tiktok-live

nodeTypes.label: TikTok: gift received
nodeTypes.description: A viewer sent a gift. Streakable gifts (the Rose and others you can tap repeatedly) count once, when the streak ends, with every tap in it. Pick a gift, or set a coin range, to react to specific gifts.

fields.label: Gift
fields.helpText: Gifts appear here as the plugin sees them. Empty accepts every gift.

fields.label: Gift id
fields.helpText: For a gift not in the list yet. Find ids with TikTok: gift lookup, or in metadata.giftId of an earlier gift.

fields.label: Coins at least
fields.helpText: Coins of the whole gift (coins per gift times the count). 0 accepts any amount.

fields.label: Coins at most
fields.helpText: Empty accepts any amount. Use with Coins at least to make bands.

fields.label: Coins per gift at least
fields.helpText: Filters by the gift's own price, whatever the count. 0 accepts any gift.

fields.label: Streakable gift
fields.helpText: Gifts that can be tapped repeatedly, like the Rose.

fields.label: Sent to the streamer
fields.helpText: In multi-guest LIVEs gifts can go to a guest. Yes keeps only gifts to the streamer.

fields.label: First gift of this viewer
fields.helpText: Yes fires only on a viewer's first gift of the session.
